=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
=== version without external dependencies ===
{{trans|Wren}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">Const SKYBLUE = Rgb(135,206,235)

Dim Shared angle As Double = 0.0

' Rotate a point around (cx,cy)
Sub RotatePoint(x As Double, y As Double, cx As Double, cy As Double, _
    Byref rx As Double, Byref ry As Double)
    
    Dim dx As Double = x - cx
    Dim dy As Double = y - cy
    
    rx = cx + dx * Cos(angle) - dy * Sin(angle)
    ry = cy + dx * Sin(angle) + dy * Cos(angle)
End Sub

' Draw rotated triangle
Sub DrawRotTriangle(cx As Double, cy As Double, _
    x1 As Double, y1 As Double, _
    x2 As Double, y2 As Double, _
    x3 As Double, y3 As Double, clr As Uinteger)
    
    Dim As Double rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2, rx3, ry3
    
    RotatePoint(x1, y1, cx, cy, rx1, ry1)
    RotatePoint(x2, y2, cx, cy, rx2, ry2)
    RotatePoint(x3, y3, cx, cy, rx3, ry3)
    
    Line (rx1, ry1)-(rx2, ry2), clr
    Line (rx2, ry2)-(rx3, ry3), clr
    Line (rx3, ry3)-(rx1, ry1), clr
    
    ' Fill triangle
    Paint ((rx1+rx2+rx3)/3, (ry1+ry2+ry3)/3), clr, clr
End Sub

' Draw rotated rectangle (two triangles)
Sub DrawRotRect(cx As Double, cy As Double, _
    x As Double, y As Double, w As Double, h As Double, clr As Uinteger)
    
    Dim As Double x1 = x,     y1 = y
    Dim As Double x2 = x + w, y2 = y
    Dim As Double x3 = x + w, y3 = y + h
    Dim As Double x4 = x,     y4 = y + h
    
    DrawRotTriangle(cx, cy, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, clr)
    DrawRotTriangle(cx, cy, x1, y1, x3, y3, x4, y4, clr)
End Sub

' Draw airplane
Sub DrawPlane()
    Dim cx As Double = 270
    Dim cy As Double = 240
    
    ' Tail fin
    DrawRotTriangle(cx, cy, 120,240, 100,160, 150,240, Rgb(80,80,80))
    
    ' Fuselage
    DrawRotRect(cx, cy, 120,220, 300,40, Rgb(80,80,80))
    
    ' Engine exhaust
    DrawRotRect(cx, cy, 100,230, 20,20, Rgb(0,0,0))
    
    ' Nose cone
    DrawRotTriangle(cx, cy, 420,220, 480,240, 420,260, Rgb(80,80,80))
    
    ' Cockpit canopy
    DrawRotTriangle(cx, cy, 380,220, 410,220, 410,235, Rgb(255,200,150))
    
    ' Main wing
    DrawRotTriangle(cx, cy, 220,240, 180,290, 280,240, Rgb(0,0,120))
    
    ' Afterburner flame
    DrawRotTriangle(cx, cy, 100,235, 70,240, 100,245, Rgb(255,0,0))
End Sub

Screenres 640, 480, 32
Windowtitle("Rotating Aircraft in FreeBASIC")
Cls

' Main loop
Do
    Screenlock
    Line (0,0)-(640,480), SKYBLUE, BF
    DrawPlane()
    Screenunlock
    
    angle += 0.015
    
    Sleep 10
Loop Until Inkey$ = Chr(27)</syntaxhighlight>

=== version SDL2 ===
{{libheader|SDL2}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">#include once "SDL2/SDL.bi"

Const ScrW = 640
Const ScrH = 480

Dim Shared angle As Double = 0.0

If SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO Or SDL_INIT_TIMER) <> 0 Then
    Print "SDL error: "; *SDL_GetError()
    Sleep: End
End If

Dim ventana As SDL_Window Ptr
Dim renderer As SDL_Renderer Ptr

ventana = SDL_CreateWindow("Rotating Aircraft - FreeBASIC + SDL2", SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED, SDL_WINDOWPOS_CENTERED, ScrW, ScrH, 0)
renderer = SDL_CreateRenderer(ventana, -1, SDL_RENDERER_ACCELERATED Or SDL_RENDERER_PRESENTVSYNC)

If renderer = 0 Then
    Print "Renderer error: "; *SDL_GetError()
    Sleep: End
End If

Sub RotatePoint(x As Double, y As Double, cx As Double, cy As Double, Byref rx As Double, Byref ry As Double)
    Dim dx As Double = x - cx
    Dim dy As Double = y - cy
    rx = cx + dx * Cos(angle) - dy * Sin(angle)
    ry = cy + dx * Sin(angle) + dy * Cos(angle)
End Sub

Sub DrawTriangle(renderer As SDL_Renderer Ptr, _
    x1 As Double, y1 As Double, _
    x2 As Double, y2 As Double, _
    x3 As Double, y3 As Double)
    
    ' Sort by Y
    If y1 > y2 Then Swap y1, y2: Swap x1, x2
    If y2 > y3 Then Swap y2, y3: Swap x2, x3
    If y1 > y2 Then Swap y1, y2: Swap x1, x2
    
    Dim As Double y, xa, xb, t1, t2
    
    For y = y1 To y3
        If y < y2 Then
            t1 = (y - y1) / (y2 - y1 + 0.00001)
            xa = x1 + (x2 - x1) * t1
        Else
            t1 = (y - y2) / (y3 - y2 + 0.00001)
            xa = x2 + (x3 - x2) * t1
        End If
        
        t2 = (y - y1) / (y3 - y1 + 0.00001)
        xb = x1 + (x3 - x1) * t2
        
        If xa > xb Then Swap xa, xb
        
        SDL_RenderDrawLine(renderer, xa, y, xb, y)
    Next
End Sub

Sub DrawRotTriangle(renderer As SDL_Renderer Ptr, cx As Double, cy As Double, _
    x1 As Double, y1 As Double, _
    x2 As Double, y2 As Double, _
    x3 As Double, y3 As Double)
    
    Dim As Double rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2, rx3, ry3
    
    RotatePoint(x1, y1, cx, cy, rx1, ry1)
    RotatePoint(x2, y2, cx, cy, rx2, ry2)
    RotatePoint(x3, y3, cx, cy, rx3, ry3)
    
    DrawTriangle(renderer, rx1, ry1, rx2, ry2, rx3, ry3)
End Sub

Sub DrawRotRect(renderer As SDL_Renderer Ptr, cx As Double, cy As Double, _
    x As Double, y As Double, w As Double, h As Double)
    
    DrawRotTriangle(renderer, cx, cy, x, y, x+w, y, x+w, y+h)
    DrawRotTriangle(renderer, cx, cy, x, y, x+w, y+h, x, y+h)
End Sub

Sub DrawPlane(renderer As SDL_Renderer Ptr)
    Dim cx As Double = 270
    Dim cy As Double = 240
    
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 80,80,80,255)
    DrawRotTriangle(renderer, cx,cy, 120,240,100,160,150,240)
    DrawRotRect    (renderer, cx,cy, 120,220,300,40)
    
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 0,0,0,255)
    DrawRotRect    (renderer, cx,cy, 100,230,20,20)
    
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 80,80,80,255)
    DrawRotTriangle(renderer, cx,cy, 420,220,480,240,420,260)
    
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 255,200,150,255)
    DrawRotTriangle(renderer, cx,cy, 380,220,410,220,410,235)
    
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 0,0,120,255)
    DrawRotTriangle(renderer, cx,cy, 220,240,180,290,280,240)
    
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 255,0,0,255)
    DrawRotTriangle(renderer, cx,cy, 100,235,70,240,100,245)
End Sub

' Main loop
Dim running As Boolean = True
Dim event As SDL_Event

While running
    While SDL_PollEvent(@event) <> 0
        If event.type = SDL_KEYDOWN And event.key.keysym.sym = SDLK_ESCAPE Then running = False
        If event.type = SDL_QUIT_ Then running = False
    Wend
    
    SDL_SetRenderDrawColor(renderer, 135,206,235,255)
    SDL_RenderClear(renderer)
    
    DrawPlane(renderer)
    
    angle += 0.015
    
    SDL_RenderPresent(renderer)
Wend

SDL_DestroyRenderer(renderer)
SDL_DestroyWindow(ventana)
SDL_Quit()</syntaxhighlight>

=== version RayLib ===
{{trans|Ring}}
{{libheader|RayLib}}
<syntaxhighlight lang="vbnet">#include once "raylib.bi"
#inclib "raylib"
#inclib "gdi32"
#inclib "winmm"
#inclib "shell32"

' Window dimensions and initialization
Const ScrW As Integer = 1024
Const ScrH As Integer = 768

InitWindow(ScrW, ScrH, "3D Airplane - FreeBASIC + Raylib")
SetTargetFPS(60)

' Camera settings
Dim camera As Camera3D
camera.position   = Vector3(8.0, 6.0, 10.0)   ' Starting position
camera.target     = Vector3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)    ' Center of the airplane
camera.up         = Vector3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)    ' Up direction vector
camera.fovy       = 45.0                      ' Field of view Y
camera.projection = CAMERA_PERSPECTIVE        ' Perspective view projection

' Animation and camera rotation variables
Dim camAngle As Single = 0.0
Dim propellerAngle As Single = 0.0
Dim camRadius As Single = 12.0

' Main loop
While Not WindowShouldClose()
    ' 1. ROTATE CAMERA AROUND THE AIRPLANE
    camAngle += 0.01
    If camAngle >= 6.28318 Then camAngle = 0.0
    
    ' Force camera into a circular orbit around the Y axis using Sine and Cosine
    camera.position.x = Sin(camAngle) * camRadius
    camera.position.z = Cos(camAngle) * camRadius
    camera.position.y = 5.0   ' Fixed height for optimal view
    
    ' Propeller rotation simulation (alternating between 1 and 2 to animate blades)
    propellerAngle += 1.0
    If propellerAngle > 2.0 Then propellerAngle = 1.0
    
    ' Start drawing
    BeginDrawing()
    ClearBackground(LIGHTGRAY)
    
    ' Start 3D Mode with the camera
    BeginMode3D(camera)
        
        ' Floor grid for better spatial awareness
        DrawGrid(20, 1.0)
        
        ' --- 3D AIRPLANE ASSEMBLY FROM STABLE PRIMITIVES ---
        ' 1. MAIN FUSELAGE (Streamlined white cylinder in the center)
        DrawCylinderEx(Vector3(0, 0, -2.5), Vector3(0, 0, 1.5), 0.7, 0.8, 16, RAYWHITE)
        
        ' 2. NOSE CONE (Cone at the front)
        DrawCylinderEx(Vector3(0, 0, 1.5), Vector3(0, 0, 2.3), 0.8, 0.1, 16, RED)
        
        ' 3. COCKPIT (Dark blue sphere on top of the fuselage)
        DrawSphere(Vector3(0, 0.5, 0.2), 0.45, DARKBLUE)
        
        ' 4. MAIN WINGS (Symmetrical boxes placed on both sides)
        ' Right wing
        DrawCube(Vector3(2.2, 0.0, 0.2), 3.5, 0.12, 1.5, BLUE)
        ' Left wing
        DrawCube(Vector3(-2.2, 0.0, 0.2), 3.5, 0.12, 1.5, BLUE)
        
        ' 5. TAIL ASSEMBLY (Stabilizers and fin)
        ' Horizontal stabilizers
        DrawCube(Vector3(0, 0.1, -2.3), 3.0, 0.08, 0.8, BLUE)
        ' Vertical stabilizer / Tail fin (Red)
        DrawCube(Vector3(0, 0.8, -2.3), 0.12, 1.2, 0.7, RED)
        
        ' 6. LANDING GEAR AND WHEELS (Under the aircraft)
        ' Left landing gear strut and wheel
        DrawCylinderEx(Vector3(-0.6, 0, 0.6), Vector3(-0.6, -1.0, 0.6), 0.08, 0.08, 8, DARKGRAY)
        DrawSphere(Vector3(-0.6, -1.0, 0.6), 0.25, BLACK)
        
        ' Right landing gear strut and wheel
        DrawCylinderEx(Vector3(0.6, 0, 0.6), Vector3(0.6, -1.0, 0.6), 0.08, 0.08, 8, DARKGRAY)
        DrawSphere(Vector3(0.6, -1.0, 0.6), 0.25, BLACK)
        
        ' Rear small tail wheel
        DrawCylinderEx(Vector3(0, -0.2, -2.2), Vector3(0, -0.7, -2.2), 0.05, 0.05, 8, DARKGRAY)
        DrawSphere(Vector3(0, -0.7, -2.2), 0.12, BLACK)
        
        ' 7. PROPELLER BLADES ANIMATION
        If propellerAngle = 1 Then
            DrawCube(Vector3(0, 0, 2.4), 0.15, 2.4, 0.05, GRAY)
        Else
            DrawCube(Vector3(0, 0, 2.4), 2.4, 0.15, 0.05, GRAY)
        End If
        
    EndMode3D()
    
    ' 2D Graphical User Interface (GUI) overlay and status panel
    DrawRectangle(10, 10, 420, 110, Fade(DARKGRAY, 0.7))
    DrawRectangleLines(10, 10, 420, 110, MAROON)
    
    DrawText("3D AIRPLANE - SOLID MODE", 25, 20, 18, GOLD)
    DrawText("Using DrawCube, DrawCylinderEx, DrawSphere", 25, 45, 14, RAYWHITE)
    DrawText("Camera: Auto-Orbit (Sin/Cos)", 25, 65, 14, LIGHTGRAY)
    DrawText("Propeller: Component-swap animation", 25, 85, 14, GREEN)
    
    'FPS counter in the top right corner
    DrawText("FPS: " & Str(GetFPS()), ScrW - 100, 20, 16, GREEN)
    
    EndDrawing()
Wend

' De-initialize and close window
CloseWindow()
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
